species.name: Turtwig
species.flavor: Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.

species.name: Grotle
species.flavor: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.

species.name: Torterra
species.flavor: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.

species.name: Chimchar
species.flavor: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can’t extinguish the fire.

species.name: Monferno
species.flavor: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.

species.name: Infernape
species.flavor: Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It is beaten by none in terms of quickness.

species.name: Piplup
species.flavor: It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.

species.name: Prinplup
species.flavor: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

species.name: Empoleon
species.flavor: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.

species.name: Starly
species.flavor: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

species.name: Staravia
species.flavor: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

species.name: Staraptor
species.flavor: The muscles in its wings and legs are strong. It can easily fly while gripping a small Pokémon.

species.name: Bidoof
species.flavor: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

species.name: Bibarel
species.flavor: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.

species.name: Kricketot
species.flavor: It chats with others using the sounds of its colliding antennae. These sounds are fall hallmarks.

species.name: Kricketune
species.flavor: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

species.name: Shinx
species.flavor: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

species.name: Luxio
species.flavor: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

species.name: Luxray
species.flavor: When its eyes gleam gold, it can spot hiding prey--even those taking shelter behind a wall.

species.name: Budew
species.flavor: When it feels the sun’s warm touch, it opens its bud to release pollen. It lives alongside clear pools.

species.name: Roserade
species.flavor: Luring prey with a sweet scent, it uses poison whips on its arms to poison, bind, and finish off the prey.

species.name: Cranidos
species.flavor: It was resurrected from an iron ball-like fossil. It downs prey with its headbutts.

species.name: Rampardos
species.flavor: Its skull withstands impacts of any magnitude. As a result, its brain never gets the chance to grow.

species.name: Shieldon
species.flavor: It habitually polishes its face by rubbing it against tree trunks. It is weak to attacks from behind.

species.name: Bastiodon
species.flavor: When they lined up side by side, no foe could break through. They shielded their young in that way.

species.name: Burmy
species.flavor: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

species.name: Wormadam
species.flavor: Its appearance changes depending on where it evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body.

species.name: Mothim
species.flavor: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by Combee.

species.name: Combee
species.flavor: The trio is together from birth. It constantly gathers honey from flowers to please Vespiquen.

species.name: Vespiquen
species.flavor: It houses its colony in cells in its body and releases various pheromones to make those grubs do its bidding.

species.name: Pachirisu
species.flavor: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

species.name: Buizel
species.flavor: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

species.name: Floatzel
species.flavor: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

species.name: Cherubi
species.flavor: Sunlight colors it red. When the small ball is drained of nutrients, it shrivels to herald evolution.

species.name: Cherrim
species.flavor: During times of strong sunlight, its bud blooms, its petals open fully, and it becomes very active.

species.name: Shellos
species.flavor: Beware of pushing strongly on its squishy body, as it makes a mysterious purple fluid ooze out.

species.name: Gastrodon
species.flavor: When its natural enemy attacks, it oozes purple fluid and escapes.

species.name: Ambipom
species.flavor: They work in large colonies and make rings by linking their tails, apparently in friendship.

species.name: Drifloon
species.flavor: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

species.name: Drifblim
species.flavor: It carries people and Pokémon when it flies. But since it only drifts, it can end up anywhere.

species.name: Buneary
species.flavor: Its ears are always rolled up. They can be forcefully extended to shatter even a large boulder.

species.name: Lopunny
species.flavor: Extremely cautious, it quickly bounds off when it senses danger.

species.name: Mismagius
species.flavor: It chants incantations. While they usually torment targets, some chants bring happiness.

species.name: Honchkrow
species.flavor: If one utters a deep cry, many Murkrow gather quickly. For this, it is called “Summoner of Night.”

species.name: Glameow
species.flavor: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

species.name: Purugly
species.flavor: It would claim another Pokémon’s nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.

species.name: Chingling
species.flavor: Each time it hops, it makes a ringing sound. It deafens foes by emitting high-frequency cries.

species.name: Stunky
species.flavor: It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon away.

species.name: Skuntank
species.flavor: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

species.name: Bronzor
species.flavor: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor’s back contained a mysterious power.

species.name: Bronzong
species.flavor: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.

species.name: Bonsly
species.flavor: It prefers arid environments. It leaks water from its eyes to adjust its body’s fluid levels.

species.name: Mime Jr.
species.flavor: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy’s movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!

species.name: Happiny
species.flavor: It carries a round, egg-shaped rock in its belly pouch and gives the rock to its friends.

species.name: Chatot
species.flavor: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it’s one of them. This way they won’t attack it.

species.name: Spiritomb
species.flavor: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

species.name: Gible
species.flavor: It nests in horizontal holes warmed by geothermal heat. Foes who get too close can expect to be pounced on and bitten.

species.name: Gabite
species.flavor: It loves sparkly things. It seeks treasures in caves and hoards the loot in its nest.

species.name: Garchomp
species.flavor: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

species.name: Munchlax
species.flavor: It hides food under its long body hair. However, it forgets it has hidden the food.

species.name: Riolu
species.flavor: It uses the shapes of auras, which change according to emotion, to communicate with others.

species.name: Lucario
species.flavor: By catching the aura emanating from others, it can read their thoughts and movements.

species.name: Hippopotas
species.flavor: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.

species.name: Hippowdon
species.flavor: It brandishes its gaping mouth in a display of fearsome strength. It raises vast quantities of sand while attacking.

species.name: Skorupi
species.flavor: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

species.name: Drapion
species.flavor: It takes pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.

species.name: Croagunk
species.flavor: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

species.name: Toxicroak
species.flavor: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.

species.name: Carnivine
species.flavor: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

species.name: Finneon
species.flavor: The line running down its side can store sunlight. It shines vividly at night.

species.name: Lumineon
species.flavor: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.

species.name: Mantyke
species.flavor: The pattern on its back varies by region. It often swims in a school of Remoraid.

species.name: Snover
species.flavor: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain’s lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.

species.name: Abomasnow
species.flavor: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as “The Ice Monster.”

species.name: Weavile
species.flavor: It lives in snowy regions. It carves patterns in trees with its claws as a signal to others.

species.name: Magnezone
species.flavor: Sometimes the magnetism emitted by Magnezone is too strong, making them attract each other so they cannot move.

species.name: Lickilicky
species.flavor: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

species.name: Rhyperior
species.flavor: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

species.name: Tangrowth
species.flavor: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

species.name: Electivire
species.flavor: As its electric charge amplifies, blue sparks begin to crackle between its horns.

species.name: Magmortar
species.flavor: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

species.name: Togekiss
species.flavor: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.

species.name: Yanmega
species.flavor: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes’ heads instantly while flying by at high speed.

species.name: Leafeon
species.flavor: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you’ll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

species.name: Glaceon
species.flavor: By controlling its body heat, it can freeze the atmosphere around it to make a diamond-dust flurry.

species.name: Gliscor
species.flavor: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

species.name: Mamoswine
species.flavor: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.

species.name: Porygon-Z
species.flavor: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.

species.name: Gallade
species.flavor: Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.

species.name: Probopass
species.flavor: It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.

species.name: Dusknoir
species.flavor: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

species.name: Froslass
species.flavor: It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees Fahrenheit. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.

species.name: Rotom
species.flavor: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

species.name: Uxie
species.flavor: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

species.name: Mesprit
species.flavor: Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

species.name: Azelf
species.flavor: Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

species.name: Dialga
species.flavor: A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It is said that time began moving when Dialga was born.

species.name: Palkia
species.flavor: It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.

species.name: Heatran
species.flavor: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

species.name: Regigigas
species.flavor: It is said to have made Pokémon that look like itself from a special ice mountain, rocks, and magma.

species.name: Giratina
species.flavor: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.

species.name: Cresselia
species.flavor: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

species.name: Phione
species.flavor: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.

species.name: Manaphy
species.flavor: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

species.name: Darkrai
species.flavor: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.

species.name: Shaymin
species.flavor: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.

species.name: Arceus
species.flavor: According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.
